unsupported: The company began as a plastics fabricator and has since expanded into a full-service distributor and custom manufacturer of high-performance plastics.

Today, Midland Plastics maintains a large inventory of plastic sheet, rod, and tube, and provides custom manufacturing services including CNC machining, thermoforming, vacuum forming, pressure forming, custom extrusions, and precision fabrication.
The facility offers production cutting and forming capabilities for both prototype and production volumes, though specific headcount and facility size are not disclosed.
Customers include OEMs and fabricators requiring materials such as acrylic, polycarbonate, and polyethylene for applications ranging from display cases to medical components.
The firm positions itself as a single source for both stock materials and custom-formed parts.

Known for: Manufacturing in the U.S. since 1945; Large stock of plastic sheet, rod, and tube; In-house plastic experts for material selection; Custom fabrication, thermoforming, and extrusion capabilities; Single source for stock and custom plastic parts
